_readme: The apartment buildings js/slopes-apartments.js draws, one file each in this folder (docs/apartments.md). `replacedBuildingIds` are the buildings-3d / buildings-roof feature ids whose flat prisms the mesh replaces (filtered out while APARTMENTS.on); `replacedNames` are the js/westcampus.js building names whose bands it replaces (filtered out of wc-wall, wc-wall-cap, wc-solid, wc-detail). Both default to every building's own id and name when omitted.
